bundles.name: Fullstack App Factory
bundles.description: End-to-end fullstack React, Node.js API, relational schema, and integration testing pipeline.

agents.name: WebCraft AI
agents.responsibilities: Design reactive user interfaces, scaffold responsive component trees with Tailwind, connect state to API contracts, and verify accessibility.
agents.expectedOutput: Responsive React 18 component tree & Cyberpunk glassmorphism layout

agents.name: SolGuard Backend AI
agents.responsibilities: Design REST & WebSocket endpoints, enforce input validation guards, handle authorization, and maintain OpenAPI specifications.
agents.expectedOutput: Secure Express REST endpoint handlers & validation middleware

agents.name: SchemaForge DB AI
agents.responsibilities: Architect normalized relational data models, define foreign keys & indexes, generate migration scripts, and enforce constraints.
agents.expectedOutput: Normalized SQL schema, migration scripts, and foreign key relations

agents.name: TestSentinel QA AI
agents.responsibilities: Run end-to-end integration tests across frontend, backend, and database; validate edge cases and certify release health.
agents.expectedOutput: Full integration test suite report with 100% pass verification

bundles.name: DeFi Research & Risk Analysis
bundles.description: Multi-venue liquidity modeling, pool depth analysis, slippage estimation, and counterparty vulnerability evaluation.
bundles.deliverableType: DeFi Protocol Audit & Risk Model Dossier

agents.name: FlashArb Protocol Scout
agents.responsibilities: Extract liquidity pool metrics across Raydium CLMM, Orca Whirlpools, and Meteora; track historical volume and pool fee curves.
agents.expectedOutput: Aggregated liquidity pool snapshot & volume volatility history

agents.name: Solana ChainScanner AI
agents.responsibilities: Analyze transaction traces, MEV sandwich patterns, LP concentration, and token holder distribution on Solana Devnet/Mainnet.
agents.expectedOutput: On-chain token distribution & transaction flow vulnerability matrix

agents.name: QuantSim Risk Engine
agents.responsibilities: Execute Monte Carlo slippage simulations, model impermanent loss scenarios, and compute Value-at-Risk (VaR) under stress conditions.
agents.expectedOutput: Stress test simulations, impermanent loss bounds, and VaR estimates

agents.name: SolGuard Certifier
agents.responsibilities: Cross-check all financial formulas, verify source data integrity, and compile executive research report with formal disclaimers.
agents.expectedOutput: Independently verified DeFi Risk Report with disclaimers

bundles.name: Healthcare Data Intelligence
bundles.description: Synthetic patient data quality audit, clinical schema validation, anomaly detection, and operational KPI reporting.
bundles.verificationCoverage: HIPAA Synthetic Boundary Check & Schema Conformance

agents.name: DataForge Healthcare Prep
agents.responsibilities: Ingest synthetic patient records, purge null critical fields, sanitize identifiers, and verify absence of raw PII.
agents.expectedOutput: PII-sanitized synthetic healthcare dataset ready for schema validation

agents.name: HL7/FHIR Schema Guard
agents.responsibilities: Validate records against standardized FHIR schema formats, check clinical code ranges (ICD-10, LOINC), and flag inconsistencies.
agents.expectedOutput: FHIR schema conformance audit & clinical code consistency report

agents.name: Biostat Analyst AI
agents.responsibilities: Compute cohort distributions, variance, hospitalization duration percentiles, and treatment group statistics.
agents.expectedOutput: Cohort descriptive statistics, quantile bounds, and outlier indices

agents.name: ComplianceSentinel QA
agents.responsibilities: Audit findings against strict healthcare guidelines, ensure no medical diagnoses are asserted, and deliver certified report.
agents.expectedOutput: Certified Healthcare Data Intelligence Report with compliance attestations

bundles.name: Data Cleaning & Analytics Factory
bundles.description: Deep 8-stage transformation of noisy enterprise data into analysis-ready datasets with measurable quality improvements.

agents.name: ProfileVision AI
agents.responsibilities: Analyze initial data schema, quantify initial missingness, detect duplicate entity keys, and establish cleaning baseline.
agents.expectedOutput: Baseline data profile with null frequency and duplicate key ratios

agents.name: DataForge AI
agents.responsibilities: Execute full 8-stage transformation: dedup, null purge, category standardization, numeric coercion, IQR capping, and median imputation.
agents.expectedOutput: Cleaned dataset with verified transforms and cryptographic proof hash

agents.name: DistroCheck AI
agents.responsibilities: Compare pre- and post-transformation distributions, verify that IQR capping preserved data structure, and test skewness.
agents.expectedOutput: Distribution preservation score and Kolmogorov-Smirnov test results

agents.name: AuditGen Quality Reporter
agents.responsibilities: Compute composite 3-dimension quality score (completeness, validity, consistency) and compile executive report.
agents.expectedOutput: Final Data Quality Report with before/after histograms and 95.2% score

bundles.name: AI/ML Model Development Pipeline
bundles.description: Reproducible machine learning training, feature selection, hyperparameter tuning, and leak-free cross-validation.
bundles.deliverableType: Trained Model Weights, Pipeline Script, and Evaluation Report

agents.name: DataForge ML-Prep
agents.responsibilities: Split training and validation sets before any preprocessing to strictly prevent data leakage; handle missing values.
agents.expectedOutput: Leak-free train/test splits with deterministic random seeds

agents.name: FeatureVector AI
agents.responsibilities: Perform one-hot encoding, target scaling, interaction terms, and mutual information feature importance ranking.
agents.expectedOutput: Normalized feature matrices with feature importance rankings

agents.name: GradientOpt ML Engine
agents.responsibilities: Train baseline logistic regression and ensemble gradient boosted trees; tune hyperparameters via 5-fold cross-validation.
agents.expectedOutput: Trained model ensemble with tuned hyperparameters

agents.name: MetricGuard Evaluator
agents.responsibilities: Evaluate model on held-out test set; compute precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC; generate calibration curves and limitations.
agents.expectedOutput: Held-out test evaluation dossier with confusion matrix and ROC curves

bundles.name: Cybersecurity & Smart Contract Audit
bundles.description: Comprehensive vulnerability discovery for Solana Anchor programs, PDA seed verification, and arithmetic invariant checking.
bundles.verificationCoverage: Bytecode Disassembly, Formal Invariants, and Fuzz Vectors
bundles.deliverableType: Formal Security Audit Certificate with Code Diff Fixes

agents.name: ReconSec Scout
agents.responsibilities: Map account structs, CPI cross-program invocation paths, instruction dispatch tables, and external program dependencies.
agents.expectedOutput: Attack surface map, entrypoint inventory, and account permission graph

agents.name: SolGuard AI
agents.responsibilities: Run Wasm AST analysis for reentrancy vectors, unvalidated account constraints, missing signer checks, and integer overflows.
agents.expectedOutput: Automated vulnerability scan findings with AST code references

agents.name: AnchorInvariant AI
agents.responsibilities: Verify Anchor PDA seeds, bump canonicalization, owner checks, and token vault segregation invariants.
agents.expectedOutput: PDA bump validation report and access-control matrix

agents.name: RedTeam Validator
agents.responsibilities: De-duplicate findings, discard false positives, assign CVSS v3.1 severity scores, and generate recommended code fixes.
agents.expectedOutput: Final certified security audit report with remediation code diffs

agents.name: BizQuant Analyzer
agents.responsibilities: Build TAM/SAM/SOM market models, compute competitor CAGR, gross margins, and cost-of-acquisition estimates.

agents.name: FactCheck Sentinel
agents.responsibilities: Cross-check all numerical claims against primary sources, flag contradictory information, and formulate executive summary.
